title: Lunch & Learn
intro: A Lunch & Learn is a format, and this page is an invitation to copy it. Take one design question your team keeps arguing about, build every competing answer for real, and run them side by side. Nothing here is mocked: every request you see really happens and every number is measured while you watch. Learn by doing: run it, slow something down, switch something off, and see for yourself what each pattern costs.
